scope: 762 exact-NCT Phase 3 trial census; per-trial endpoint adjudications require primary readout evidence
note: 43 exact-NCT adjudications; 10 added from Agios and Axsome investor relations, distinguishing Bayesian failures and randomized withdrawal studies from FDA decisions.

records.rationale: Amylyx PHOENIX Phase 3 study of AMX0035 in ALS did not meet prespecified Week 48 ALSFRS-R change primary endpoint versus placebo (p=0.667); company announced March 8, 2024. Registry recruitment status UNKNOWN is separate from the observed outcome.
records.qualification: Exact-NCT sponsor drug/indication/readout crosswalk; primary endpoint miss only; not a new FDA or trading decision

records.rationale: ABTECT Maintenance (Study 107) obefazimod Phase 3 Week 44 clinical remission primary endpoint met for both 25 mg and 50 mg once-daily arms versus placebo (50.8% and 51.3% vs 10.4%; both p<0.0001). Exact NCT linked by the sponsor announcement (ABTECT program listing) and registry sponsor protocol ABX464-107. Public announcement June 1, 2026.
records.qualification: Observed primary endpoint only. This does not prove NDA filed or FDA approval.

records.rationale: LUCIDITY Phase 3 avexitide study in post-bariatric hypoglycemia met the prespecified primary composite of Level 2/3 hypoglycemic events through Week 16: 55% reduction compared with placebo, p=0.000003. Amylyx official news announcement August 18, 2026 explicitly ties LUCIDITY to NCT06747468.
records.qualification: Observed primary endpoint only. Planned NDA by end of 2026 is not a verified FDA acceptance or approval.

records.rationale: ABTECT-1 (Abivax Study ABX464-105): obefazimod 50 mg daily and 25 mg daily each met the prespecified Phase 3 Week 8 clinical remission primary endpoint versus placebo (50 mg placebo-adjusted +19.3%, p<0.0001; 25 mg placebo-adjusted +21.4%, p<0.0001). Sponsor Phase 3 induction readout published July 22, 2025; exact NCT linked to Study 105 on ClinicalTrials.gov.
records.qualification: Primary-endpoint success applies to specified doses; not FDA approval.

records.rationale: ABTECT-2 (Abivax Study ABX464-106): obefazimod 50 mg daily met the prespecified Phase 3 Week 8 clinical remission primary endpoint versus placebo (placebo-adjusted +13.4%, p=0.0001); the separate 25 mg arm did not meet significance (p=0.1034). Sponsor induction readout published July 22, 2025; exact NCT linked to Study 106.
records.qualification: Mixed-dose result. Trial-level PASS refers to 50 mg prespecified primary comparison only; 25 mg missed significance. Not FDA approval.

records.rationale: Acadia LAVENDER trial of trofinetide in Rett syndrome met both prespecified Week 12 co-primary outcomes: RSBQ p=0.0175 and CGI-I p=0.0030. Published trial paper explicitly identifies NCT04181723; company press release Dec 6, 2021.
records.qualification: Phase 3 outcomes met, distinct from any subsequent FDA decision; peer reviewed: https://www.nature.com/articles/s41591-023-02398-1

records.rationale: Agios RISE UP sickle cell disease trial has TWO prespecified primary endpoints: hemoglobin response MET (40.6% mitapivat versus 2.9% placebo, two-sided p<0.0001); annualized sickle cell pain crises DID NOT meet significance (p=0.1213). The trial's prespecified success criterion allowed significance for at least one primary endpoint. Thus this is MIXED primary-endpoint evidence, not success on every primary endpoint. Official sponsor readout Nov 19, 2025.
records.qualification: One of two co-primary outcomes did not achieve statistical significance; the favorable trial-level label must not conceal that. Sponsor reported FDA sNDA review and Feb 1, 2027 PDUFA date in Nov 5, 2026 corporate update, independent FDA confirmation not established.

records.rationale: Arrowhead SHASTA-3 Phase 3 plozasiran in severe hypertriglyceridemia met its prespecified Month 12 primary triglyceride-reduction endpoint versus placebo (median 79% reduction from baseline; p<0.0001). Sponsor Aug 30, 2026 readout explicitly identifies NCT06347003 for SHASTA-3.
records.qualification: Reported primary endpoint only. Pooled acute pancreatitis analysis spans SHASTA-3 and SHASTA-4, not per-study outcome. Planned sNDA is not an approved application.

records.rationale: Arrowhead SHASTA-4 Phase 3 plozasiran in severe hypertriglyceridemia met its prespecified Month 12 primary triglyceride-reduction endpoint versus placebo (median 81% reduction from baseline; p<0.0001). Sponsor Aug 30, 2026 readout explicitly identifies NCT06347016 for SHASTA-4.
records.qualification: Reported primary endpoint only. Pooled acute pancreatitis analysis spans SHASTA-3 and SHASTA-4, not per-study outcome. Planned sNDA is not an approved application.

records.rationale: Achieve ORCA-2 Phase 3 cytisinicline smoking-cessation study met its prespecified biochemically confirmed continuous abstinence primary comparisons versus placebo: 6-week 25.3% vs 4.4%, and 12-week 32.6% vs 7.0% (both p<0.0001 in sponsor release). Exact NCT confirmed in peer-reviewed JAMA 2023 trial report PMID 37432430.
records.qualification: Positive clinical primary-endpoint result, not an FDA approval. On 2026-06-22 the company announced its cytisinicline NDA had received an FDA Complete Response Letter dated 2026-06-20 for third-party manufacturing and unfinished labeling, with no efficacy or safety deficiencies identified.

records.rationale: Achieve ORCA-3 confirmatory Phase 3 cytisinicline trial met both prespecified continuous smoking abstinence primary comparisons: 6-week 14.8% vs 6.0% placebo (sponsor p=0.0008); 12-week 30.3% vs 9.4% placebo (sponsor p<0.0001). Exact NCT confirmed by peer-reviewed JAMA Internal Medicine 2025 report PMID 40257755.
records.qualification: Positive clinical primary-endpoint result, not an FDA approval. On 2026-06-22 the company announced its cytisinicline NDA had received an FDA Complete Response Letter dated 2026-06-20 for third-party manufacturing and unfinished labeling, with no efficacy or safety deficiencies identified.

records.rationale: Acadia ENHANCE-1 (ACP-103-034) Phase 3 adjunctive pimavanserin for schizophrenia: full-population week-6 PANSS total-score primary endpoint missed statistical significance (p=0.0940), despite positive regional and secondary/exploratory analyses. Sponsor July 22, 2019 readout explicitly describes 396 randomized participants; registry NCT02970292 verifies the same study code, title and enrollment.
records.qualification: Primary schizophrenia efficacy endpoint FAIL; secondary/subgroup signals are not an override. Not an FDA CRL, drug approval status, or trading conclusion.

records.rationale: Acadia ADVANCE-2 (ACP-103-064) Phase 3 adjunctive pimavanserin for predominant negative symptoms of schizophrenia failed the prespecified 26-week NSA-16 primary endpoint: treatment -11.8 vs placebo -11.1, p=0.4825. Sponsor March 11, 2024 announcement and peer-reviewed PMID 40181715 agree. Trial ID verified by NCT04531982 protocol and EudraCT 2019-003343-29.
records.qualification: Clinical primary-endpoint FAIL, not a regulatory application decision. Do not substitute positive phase-2 ADVANCE evidence for the distinct negative phase-3 ADVANCE-2 study.

records.rationale: Acadia HARMONY (NCT03325556) randomized-withdrawal Phase 3 pimavanserin in dementia-related psychosis met the prespecified primary endpoint of time to relapse after open-label stabilization. 12/95 (13%) of continuing-pimavanserin participants relapsed vs 28/99 (28%) placebo; hazard ratio 0.35 (95% CI 0.17–0.73), two-sided p=0.005. Trial stopped at prespecified interim efficacy analysis. Published NEJM 2021 report explicitly identifies NCT03325556.
records.qualification: Positive randomized-withdrawal clinical relapse-prevention result applies to initial responders; does not imply efficacy in the entire screened population or FDA labeling approval for dementia-related psychosis.

records.rationale: ACTIVATE: Sustained Hb response at least 1.5 g/dL: 40% mitapivat vs 0% placebo, two-sided p<0.0001. Exact NCT crosswalk: ACTIVATE adult nonregularly transfused PK deficiency = NCT03548220; distinct from ACTIVATE-T.
records.qualification: Randomized, double-blind hemoglobin primary endpoint; not an FDA approval.

records.rationale: ACTIVATE-T: Transfusion reduction response ≥33% in 10/27 patients (37%), one-sided p=0.0002 vs prespecified ≤10% null. Exact NCT crosswalk: ACTIVATE-T adults regularly transfused = NCT03559699, open-label single-arm study.
records.qualification: Statistical comparator was a prespecified historical threshold, not concurrent placebo.

records.rationale: ACTIVATE-KidsT (AG348-C-022): Prespecified Bayesian statistical primary criterion NOT met at low/moderate adult borrowing weights; 9/32 (28.1%) treated vs 2/17 (11.8%) placebo achieved transfusion reduction. Exact NCT crosswalk: ACTIVATE-KidsT pediatric regularly transfused protocol AG348-C-022 = NCT05144256.
records.qualification: Numerically favorable clinical result must not be mislabeled a statistical PASS.

records.rationale: ACTIVATE-Kids (AG348-C-023): Prespecified Bayesian hemoglobin-response primary criterion met at every 0–1 adult-borrowing weight; 6/19 (31.6%) active vs 0/11 placebo; between-arm 95% CI 10.8% to 52.7%. Exact NCT crosswalk: ACTIVATE-Kids pediatric not regularly transfused protocol AG348-C-023 = NCT05175105.
records.qualification: Bayesian study-specific PASS; do not confuse with failed ACTIVATE-KidsT.

records.rationale: ADVANCE-1 (AXS-05-AD-301): Week-5 CMAI score primary endpoint met: mean improvement 15.4 with AXS-05 vs 11.5 placebo, p=0.010. Exact NCT crosswalk: NCT03226522 registry titles ADVANCE-1 and AXS-05-AD-301; a Phase 2/3 study included in Phase 3 census.
records.qualification: Phase 2/3 positive trial is separate from negative ADVANCE-2.

records.rationale: ADVANCE-2: Week-5 CMAI total-score primary endpoint not significant: -13.8 AXS-05 vs -12.6 placebo in 408 randomized patients. Exact NCT crosswalk: NCT05557409 is explicitly named ADVANCE-2 in registry; not ADVANCE-1.
records.qualification: Clinical endpoint FAIL despite positive program-level NDA outcome.

records.rationale: ACCORD-1: Randomized-withdrawal primary time to agitation relapse met: HR 0.275, p=0.014. Exact NCT crosswalk: NCT04797715 corresponds to ACCORD-1 randomized-withdrawal study; distinct from ACCORD-2.
records.qualification: Responder-enriched randomized withdrawal evidence, not treatment initiation in unselected population.

records.rationale: ACCORD-2: Primary time to agitation relapse met in randomized-withdrawal study: HR 0.276, p=0.001; secondary relapse prevention p=0.001. Exact NCT crosswalk: NCT04947553 is ACCORD-2 open-label plus double-blind randomized withdrawal study.
records.qualification: Responder-enriched withdrawal design and not an independent FDA approval.

records.rationale: SYMPHONY (AXS-12-301): Week-5 weekly cataplexy frequency primary endpoint met vs placebo: rate ratio 0.49, p=0.018. Exact NCT crosswalk: NCT05059223 is SYMPHONY Phase 3 narcolepsy study; distinct from ENCORE.
records.qualification: Positive primary result does not mean FDA approved AXS-12.

records.rationale: ENCORE (AXS-12-302): Randomized-withdrawal primary week-3 cataplexy frequency increase: 1.32 attacks/week on continued AXS-12 vs 10.29 on placebo withdrawal, p=0.017 (42 randomized). Exact NCT crosswalk: NCT05113745 is ENCORE long-term randomized withdrawal Phase 3; not SYMPHONY.
records.qualification: Responder/exposure-selected withdrawal evidence; not randomized initial treatment for all.
